rules.title: Sikkim: Protected Area Permit for border areas
rules.detail: Needed for Tsomgo, Nathu La, Zuluk to Kupup, Lachen, Lachung, Thangu and Gurudongmar. Issued by the Permit Cell in Gangtok and district tourism offices. The page gives no fee amounts.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

history.change: Blogs report permits became digital with a scannable code, applied for online before arrival.

rules.title: Sikkim: motorcycle must be registered to the rider
rules.detail: The official page allows only self-registered, self-ridden motorcycles in permit areas. Apply one day ahead with the bank fee receipt. Two-wheeler permits run up to seven days.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Sikkim: rented motorcycles apply through a registered operator
rules.detail: A motorcycle hired inside Sikkim gets its permit through a government-registered local tour operator, not directly by the rider.
rules.applies_to: Riders on motorcycles rented in Sikkim
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Sikkim: proposed bar on two-wheelers in permit areas
rules.detail: Proposal discussed on 19 August 2026 would bar two-wheelers and vehicles registered outside Sikkim from permit areas. It needs Cabinet approval. No decision found as of 28 September 2026.
rules.applies_to: All two-wheelers; all vehicles registered outside Sikkim

source.title: Sikkim may bar two-wheelers from RAP, PAP areas under proposed permit norms

history.change: Proposal raised at a stakeholder meeting chaired by the Chief Minister; reported as not yet in effect.

rules.title: Nathu La: no permits for Mondays
rules.detail: The official page issues Nathu La permits for Tuesday to Sunday only. Other sources list fewer open days, so confirm in Gangtok the day before.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Nathu La: Indian citizens only, one-day visit
rules.detail: The official page limits Nathu La to Indian citizens on a day trip. A Tsomgo permit is also valid for one day only.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Nathu La: environment fee paid through the bank
rules.detail: Paid through the State Bank of Sikkim. Sikkim-registered private motorcycles skip permit fees elsewhere but still pay for Nathu La. The page gives no amount.
rules.applies_to: All vehicles going to Nathu La
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Tsomgo and Nathu La: permits suspended after snowfall
rules.detail: The tourism department stops issuing permits when snow or black ice makes the road unsafe, and resumes once it is cleared.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Heavy Snowfall in Sikkim: Tourist Permits Suspended, Road, Nathula and Tsomgo Lake Closed

history.change: Permits stopped after snowfall; the department notified their resumption in mid-October 2023.

source.title: Sikkim government to start issuing tourist permits for Tsomgo Lake and Nathula Pass

history.change: Permits suspended after heavy snowfall and black ice; reported 10 January 2025.

rules.title: Zuluk: sources disagree on private vehicles
rules.detail: One blog says only Sikkim-registered hired vehicles may run the Silk Route. A travel site describes riding it on a permit from Rongli. No official statement found.

source.title: Zuluk Travel Guide 2026 | Silk Route Sikkim

rules.title: Zuluk: closed to foreign citizens, per blog
rules.detail: A blog updated in August 2026 says Zuluk and the Silk Route stay closed to foreign citizens even with a Restricted Area Permit. No official order found.
rules.set_by: Not established; reported by a blog

source.title: Zuluk Travel Guide 2026 | Silk Route Sikkim

rules.title: Sikkim: 150cc minimum claimed for permit areas
rules.detail: Blogs say motorcycles under 150cc are refused permits for North Sikkim, Nathu La and Zuluk. The official page does not mention engine size; no order found.

source.title: Sikkim Bike Permit Rules: What Every Rider Needs to Know Before Hitting North Sikkim in 2026

rules.title: Sikkim: Aadhaar not accepted as proof of nationality
rules.detail: The official tourism page says an Aadhaar card is not accepted as proof of citizenship or nationality when applying for permits.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Sikkim: papers riders are asked for
rules.detail: A travel site lists photo identity, driving licence, registration, insurance and pollution certificates, plus photographs, in duplicate. No official list found.
rules.set_by: Not established; reported by a travel site

source.title: How to self drive a motorbike or car in Sikkim

rules.title: Sikkim: foreign citizens need a Restricted Area Permit
rules.detail: Valid 30 days, extendable by 30 in Gangtok. Protected areas need a group routed through a registered operator. Bhutanese citizens are exempt.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

rules.title: Sikkim: foreign riders need an International Driving Licence
rules.detail: Stated on the official tourism page. A foreigner's two-wheeler pass covers one day to Tsomgo, or up to five days in North Sikkim.
rules.set_by: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department, Government of Sikkim

source.title: Tourism and Civil Aviation Department: general information

season.note: There is no fixed seasonal closure; permits are suspended for days at a time after snowfall, mostly between December and February.

gaps: No report found of a Cabinet decision on the 19 August 2026 two-wheeler proposal: one web search and the Sikkim front pages of two news sites were checked on 28 September 2026.
Open days for Nathu La conflict: the official page says Tuesday to Sunday; Wikipedia says Thursday to Sunday; a travel site says Wednesday to Sunday.
No official statement found on whether a private motorcycle may ride the Zuluk route; two unofficial sources contradict each other.
No dated winter closure and reopening dates found for Nathu La for 2024 or 2026.
Highway number for the Zuluk to Rongli side not sourced.
No official source for the 150cc minimum or the documents list.
The vehicle pass portal vehiclepass.sikkim.gov.in could not be opened (certificate error).
Fee amounts are not on the official page and are left out.

pumps_from_companies.why: The open map has no pump between Gangtok and Rongli, over Nathu La and Zuluk. Neither IndianOil's nor HP's own locator, read on 6 October 2026 for Gangtok and East Sikkim, lists one there either, so nothing is added.
